See the spec's §8 three-tier validity hierarchy.

documented_limitations_at_freeze_time: M/X/A candidate correctness is NOT established by this audit (semantic validity - open, see spec §8).
Sufficiency of 6 primary compositions to characterize score's aggregation behavior is NOT established (research validity - open).
Threshold optimality is NOT established - only that the thresholds are load-bearing (changing them changes results), which is a different claim from correctness.

The [0,0,0,9] mode/max/mean-separation fixture demonstrates the IMPLEMENTATION distinguishes these three statistics; it does NOT establish which statistic is the correct semantic target for Jev's `score` primitive.
Single domain, n=4 sentences, 3 severity levels - explicitly scoped, not claimed general (spec §4).
No API calls have been made under this specification. Nothing here characterizes live Jev behavior - only the pre-registered procedure that would later be applied to it.
